children: Dr Ing hc F Porsche AG
REORGANISATION OF PORSCHE SALES FOR CLOSER INTEGRATION BETWEEN REGIONS AND HEAD OFFICE
INTERNATIONAL MANAGEMENT POSITIONS AT SEVERAL PORSCHE SALES SUBSIDIARIES TO BE NEWLY APPOINTED.
MARKETS GIVEN GREATER RESPONSIBILITY AS PART OF RESTRUCTURING.
NEW STRUCTURE IS SCHEDULED TO TAKE EFFECT FROM 1 OCTOBER, 2026.
AS PART OF REORGANISATION, EXISTING CENTRAL DEPARTMENTS FOR EUROPE AND OVERSEAS AND EMERGING MARKETS REGIONS WILL BE DISSOLVED
IN FUTURE, NUMBER OF SALES REGIONS WILL BE REDUCED FROM FIVE TO FOUR. GERMANY, AS PORSCHE'S HOME MARKET, WILL BECOME PART OF EUROPE REGION
